title: News and blogs
intro: Read the latest news, views and stories from Toynbee Hall and the communities we work alongside.

blocks.heading: What this Budget must deliver for a stronger social safety net
paragraphs: Katie Taylor, Director of Policy, Research & Communities, considers how the Budget can strengthen the social safety net. Published 27 October 2026.

blocks.heading: Toynbee Hall shortlisted for national technology award
paragraphs: The nomination for Best Use of Technology at the UKCCF Awards 2026 recognises the development and deployment of Video Advice Kiosks.

blocks.heading: Learning across borders on debt advice
paragraphs: A recent visit to London explored what the UK and South Korea can learn from each other about supporting people in debt.
